title: Lesson 8: Radiating Across the Ten Directions — Abiding with Brahmā

suttaRef.title: The Three Knowledges (Tevijjasutta — DN 13)
suttaRef.excerptPali: Seyyathāpi, vāseṭṭha, balavā saṅkhadhamo appassēneva catuddisā viññāpeyya; evameva kho, vāseṭṭha, evaṃ bhāvitāya mettāya cetovimuttiyā... yaṃ pamāṇakataṃ kammaṃ, na taṃ tatrāvasissati, na taṃ tatrāvatiṭṭhati. Ayampi kho, vāseṭṭha, brahmānaṃ sahabyatāya maggo.
suttaRef.excerptTranslation: Just as a mighty trumpeter, Vāseṭṭha, with little effort makes himself heard in all four directions; so too, when the mind-deliverance of loving-kindness is cultivated in this way... whatever limited karma has been done cannot remain there, cannot persist there. This is the direct path to communion with Brahmā!

pariyatti.shortSummary: In the Tevijja Sutta (DN 13), the Buddha shatters Vedic dogmas regarding union with Brahmā: God is not reached through bloody animal sacrifices or bathing in holy rivers, but through resonance with divine qualities: purity, harmlessness, and radiating the Four Boundless States across the cosmos.

coreConcepts.definition: Simile for the resonant power of boundless love dissolving darkness effortlessly across space.
The infinite magnitude of Brahmavihāra overwhelms and dilutes petty past misdeeds.
East, West, North, South, intermediate directions, Zenith (Above), and Nadir (Below).

pariyatti.expositionMarkdown:
### 1. The Lump of Salt in the Ganges (AN 3.99)
- Cast a lump of salt into a tiny cup ➔ The water turns briny and undrinkable (a petty, narrow mind suffers intensely from trivial slights).
- Cast that same salt into the vast Ganges River ➔ The river flows on cool, pure, and sweet, completely absorbing the salt without a trace!
When you radiate boundless Brahmavihāra, your heart becomes the Ganges. Worldly irritations dissolve effortlessly in your ocean of peace!

### 2. Daily Universal Radiation Practice
- East, West, North, South, Above, Below.
- From highest celestial planes to the deepest infernal depths, no sentient creature is abandoned outside your heart's perimeter. In that moment, you embody a living Brahmā on earth!

commonMisconceptions.mistake: Dismissing universal radiation as wishful imaginary daydreaming.
commonMisconceptions.correction: Neuroscience studies on contemplative compassion demonstrate massive neuroplastic restructuring of prefrontal cortex and tangible biometric coherence.

commonMisconceptions.mistake: Assuming Brahmavihāra absorption equals full final enlightenment.
commonMisconceptions.correction: Brahmavihāra leads to Brahmā heavens. For final Nibbāna, one must pivot this tranquility into Vipassanā observing the Three Characteristics.

patipatti.practiceGuide:
1. 15-20 Minute Ten-Direction Meditation:  
   - Front: 'May all beings before me be well.'  
   - Back, Right, Left, Above, Below: 'May all beings be free from fear.'  
   - Global Pervasion: Visualize the planet bathed in your golden radiance.
2. Carry this divine demeanor throughout your day.
patipatti.suggestedVirtue: Vastness of heart like open space, embracing all life without discrimination.

pativedha.reflectionPrompt: While radiating love across all directions, did you feel the prison boundary between 'Self and Other' dissolve into an ocean of unity?
selfAuditChecklist: I completed the ten-direction meditation with focused devotion.
I excluded no one—not even rivals—from my blessing of peace.
My heart tasted boundless buoyancy, cleansed of worldly pettiness.
